verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I speak to all the tribes of the children of Israel, and I say to them: “You shall be holy, for I, the LORD your God, am holy.”
verses.3: May their father and mother be afraid, and may they keep my commandments. I, the LORD your God, will do this.
verses.4: Do not worship the idols and gods of falsehood. Do not do those things that I, Jehovah your God, have commanded you not to do.
verses.5: And when you offer sacrifices of holiness to Jehovah, I will accept them for your sake.
verses.6: On the day of your sacrifice, it will be eaten. From the afternoon onward, until the third day, it will be burned by fire.
verses.7: And if it is eaten on the third day, then it will not be acceptable.
verses.8: And their food will be cursed, for they have profaned the holiness of Jehovah. That soul will be marked as unclean among their people.
verses.9: And when you harvest the crops from your land, do not waste any of them. Do not throw away any of the grains you have harvested.
verses.10: And your vineyards shall not be plundered, and your crops shall not be taken by the poor. I, the LORD your God, will protect them.
verses.11: Do not steal, do not lie, and do not cheat one’s neighbor.
verses.12: And do not commit deceit in my name. You have profaned the name of your God. I, Jehovah, am God.
verses.13: Do not exploit your servant, and do not steal from him. Do not assign any tasks to him that require hard work until evening.
verses.14: Do not harm the poor and needy. Do not give anything away to those who are in need. Fear Me, for I am the LORD.
verses.15: Do not act unjustly in judgment. Do not show favor to the lowly, and do not treat the noble with dishonor. Judge your neighbors fairly.
verses.16: Do not let robbers go free among your people. Do not allow them to stand over your blood. I, the LORD, will do so.
verses.17: Do not despise your brother in your heart. Love your neighbors, and do not bring sin upon yourself.
verses.18: Do not do this: do not harm or kill your own people. And love your neighbors as yourself, for I am the LORD.
verses.19: You shall keep my laws in your land. You shall not plow your fields with oxen, nor sow crops with oxen. And you shall not wear clothes made of oxhide.
verses.20: And a man who sleeps with a woman who is a descendant of a noble family, and she is a wife who has been defiled by him. She cannot be saved; she will not be freed from this situation. She will not be able to live anymore, because she has been defiled.
verses.21: And he brought his sin offerings to Jehovah at the entrance of the Temple of the Lord.
verses.22: And the priest shall offer a grain offering before Jehovah for his sin. He has sinned, but he is forgiven from his sins.
verses.23: And when you enter the land, and plant all kinds of edible trees, and harvest their fruits for three years, they will become unpalatable to you.
verses.24: And in the fourth year, all fruits will be sacred and set aside for Jehovah.
verses.25: And in the fifth year, you shall eat the fruit of it, so that it may increase for you. I, the LORD your God, will do this.
verses.26: Do not eat on blood; do not drink wine, and do not offer us any sacrifices.
verses.27: Do not cut off the branches of your head, and do not destroy the branches of your old age.
verses.28: And let your souls not be marked with marks or tattoos. And let your writings not be erased from your bodies. I, the LORD, will do this.
verses.29: Do not defile your daughter for the purpose of prostitution. Do not also defile the land; for the land is full of wrath.
verses.30: You shall keep my Sabbaths, and you shall fear my holy places. I, the LORD, am your God.
verses.31: Do not turn to the fathers and wise men. Do not seek their advice. I, Jehovah your God, am your God.
verses.32: Because Sheva was raised up, and you feared the old man and obeyed your God. I am Jehovah.
verses.33: And if a stranger lives among you in your land, do not accept him as one of your own people.
verses.34: As a foreigner among you, he will become your neighbor. Love him as you would love your own neighbors, just as you were strangers in the land of Egypt. I, the LORD your God, am your God.
verses.35: They shall not act in a manner that is unfair or unjust in judgment, in measurements, or in weighing.
verses.36: From now on, I will be your God, the One who has brought you out of Egypt. I will be your God, and righteousness will be your portion. I, Jehovah your God, will be your God.
verses.37: And you shall keep all my laws and all my decrees. And I, the LORD, will do these things for you.
